title: Te Ariki i Tono i te Atuatanga
intro: I whakapono tētahi rangatira mana nui, whakakake hoki kāore tetahi e tū ki runga ake i tōna torona. I whaia e rātou tētahi rōpū e rere ana i tētahi wai nui, ā, ka mate pōuri rātou. E pārekareka ana te kōrero a tēnei ariki ki ngā kōrero maha o te Quran, hei whakatūpato ki te katoa.
clues: He rangatira whai mana ahau, i whakapono kāore he mana i tua atu i tōku ake i ngā whenua i whakahaerea e au.
He wizier pono tōku, ko Hamana tōna ingoa, ā, i āwhina ia i ahau ki te whakahaere i ngā kaupapa hanga whare nunui.
I karangatia e ahau ngā tohunga makutu tino pai o tōku whenua ki te wero i ngā tohu a te anahera i whakahē i ahau.
I whakakahore ahau ki te tuku i te iwi e herehere ana i roto i tōku kingitanga kia haere, ahakoa ngā mate urutā me ngā whakatūpato mārama.
I whaia rātou e ahau i te moana nui me taku ope katoa me aku hariata.
I taupokina mātou ko aku ope e taua moana, ā, i toremi katoa mātou, i a rātou e whiti ora ana.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Ngā mate urutā me te pakanga ki a Mohi (Mōhi)
Te hanga i tētahi āka i mua i te waipuke nui
Te pakanga ki a Jalut i te awaawa
Te tiaki i ngā taumaha hokohoko pono
trial.answer: Ngā mate urutā me te pakanga ki a Mohi (Mōhi)

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ngā pourewa teitei me ngā pou
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
location.answer: Ngā pourewa teitei me ngā pou

outcome.label: Hua
options: I toremi ki te moana me te ope taua
I whakaorangia e te aroha o Allah, ā, i utua te manawanui
Kua hoki anō ki te whānau i muri i ngā tau maha o te uauatanga
outcome.answer: I toremi ki te moana me te ope taua

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
